answer: Forked Walnut Challenge: each epoch, a beacon publishes a summit hash. Every identity must sign two divergent lotus branches over a walnut seed, updating separate nonce chains and proving branch divergence. Clones sharing state can only emit one branch; later forks trigger nonce-collision gossip. Attacker cost: one hardware-isolated entropy source, continuous VDF work, and separate storage per identity—N sybils require N independent chains.
